message: The commit changes only tests. Combine it with the fix before it, if you haven't pushed, or amend with `git commit --amend` to include the fix. Then run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt` again.

item: the commit's test fails without its fix: with the other files it changes as they were before it, `npm test` fails
name: no saved commit
message: After you commit the fix, run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt`.

item: the commit's test fails without its fix: with the other files it changes as they were before it, `npm test` fails
name: commit has no tests
message: The commit changes no test file, so no test runs without the fix. Ask Claude to add one to the fix commit, then `git commit --amend` and run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt` again.

item: the commit's test fails without its fix: with the other files it changes as they were before it, `npm test` fails
name: commit has tests alone
message: The commit changes only tests. Combine it with the fix before it, if you haven't pushed, or amend with `git commit --amend` to include the fix. Then run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt` again.

item: the commit's test fails without its fix: with the other files it changes as they were before it, `npm test` fails
name: first commit has no previous code
message: 02d5d062a777d69a94a1208a6f074e8a1f4a7591 is the first commit in this repository, so there is no code from before the fix to test.

item: the commit's test fails without its fix: with the other files it changes as they were before it, `npm test` fails
name: tests pass without fix
message: Without the fix, `npm test` still passes, so the new test doesn't catch the bug. Add a regression test that fails on the old code, amend the fix and run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt` again.

item: the reported bug is fixed: a missing folder in `linkcheck.json` makes the tool exit with code 2 and name the folder
name: error omits missing folder
message: The tool exits with code 2, but its error doesn't name the missing folder, `docs`. Fix that inside the plan, amend the commit and run `git rev-parse HEAD > .practice/capstone-commit.txt` again.
